items.q: Al Jackson or Roger Hawkins... pick out a hero, pick out somebody you really want to emulate... Whether it’s Bernard Purdie or Al Jackson or Roger Hawkins

ctx.x: Yes. And that’s a point of departure, you know and at that moment — somebody said, “You’re very diplomatic.” So my diplomacy kind of kicks in and detente comes to mind © Fillius Jazz Archive -4-

where okay they don’t want me to do what I do naturally or instinctually or what I prepared to do when I first heard about this song or this album. So leave all that behind and start fresh. And I take their direction or the producer’s direction, you know, don’t do this, do this, can you make it sound like this, can you make it go faster, slower, louder, softer.
